svg.text: The coach asks for one clip on the right; the stage on the left shows the frame it needs.

g.text: down the line · 2.4–3.7 m behind your hands

text.tspan: Ready when you are. Send me one swing, filmed
down the line. Before you press record:

g.text: Behind you, along the target line.
On your bag or a tripod.
Slow-motion setting, if you have it.
Trim to one swing, max 15 s.
The left side shows the frame I need.
Drop the clip below. I only keep it if you ask me to.

text.tspan: · mp4 or mov · max 15 s · one swing

g.text: Off by default. If on, the swing clip is stored on the AIcoach server until you delete it.
Questions open once the result is ready.

svg.text: The clip lands on the stage. Body lines and swing events appear there while the steps stream in on the right.

g.text: pins fill in as I measure

it now; this takes under a minute.
